description: This line plot illustrates the similarity scores across different model layers for four language pair combinations: en&en (red solid line), en&el (green solid line), en&es (blue solid line), and en&bn (magenta solid line). The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” spans from approximately 0 to 22, representing the depth of the model’s layers, with major tick marks at intervals of 2. The y-axis, labeled “Similarity,” ranges from 0.05 to 0.45, with tick marks every 0.05 units, indicating the degree of similarity measured between representations. All four lines exhibit a generally increasing trend from early to later layers, with notable fluctuations. The red line (en&en) starts around 0.09 at layer 0, peaks near 0.34 at layer 4, dips to about 0.24 at layer 6, and then rises sharply after layer 20, reaching approximately 0.48 at layer 22. The green line (en&el) begins near 0.06, peaks around 0.23 at layer 4, drops to 0.18 at layer 6, and ends near 0.35 at layer 22. The blue line (en&es) starts at about 0.07, peaks at 0.32 at layer 4, dips to 0.24 at layer 6, and ends near 0.46 at layer 22. The magenta line (en&bn) begins around 0.05, peaks at 0.22 at layer 4, dips to 0.18 at layer 6, and ends near 0.47 at layer 22. All lines show a pronounced upward surge in similarity in the final layers (beyond layer 20), with the en&en line reaching the highest value.
